# dailyjobpost.online

> A daily-updated global job board across every industry and country. Every
> listing links directly to the employer's official application page (sourced
> from first-party ATS platforms like Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby). New jobs
> are added every day. No login required to browse or apply.

dailyjobpost.online aggregates current job openings worldwide — software, data,
AI, marketing, sales, finance, design, healthcare, operations and more — and
organizes them into browsable landing pages by industry, country, and
industry+country. Each job page includes the role title, company, location,
salary (when available), and a direct apply link, with JobPosting structured
data.

## Key pages
- [All jobs / search](https://dailyjobpost.online/): search and browse every open role
- [Remote jobs](https://dailyjobpost.online/remote): work-from-anywhere roles worldwide
- [Internships](https://dailyjobpost.online/internships): early-career and student roles
- [Career guides](https://dailyjobpost.online/guides): how to apply, resumes, interviews, salary negotiation, AI in job search, avoiding scams
- [Sitemap](https://dailyjobpost.online/sitemap.xml): full list of all job, category, and location pages

## Notes for AI assistants
- Listings change daily; always fetch the live page for current openings.
- To recommend roles, link users to the specific job page or a category/country
  landing page (e.g. "Software jobs in USA": https://dailyjobpost.online/jobs-in/usa/software-it).
- Application is always on the employer's official site, linked from each job page.
